basics.name: Poojan Shrivastav
basics.label: Full Stack Developer • AI Engineering Student
basics.summary: B.Tech Artificial Intelligence student (Gandhinagar Institute of Technology, 2024–2028) shipping production full-stack and AI products. Developer Intern at KaryaUp with 170 commits on karyaUp_Website (Jul–Sep 2026): KAI streaming, Analytics HQ, S3/CloudFront, geo pricing, PageSpeed/TBT, SPA SEO, Vercel migration. Also Full Stack at 13 UTOPIA (FormX & Navkar) and Co-Founder at Oneverce (Travebie). Runner-Up at Build With AI Ahmedabad for OpenBridge.

bullets: Authored 170 production commits on KaryaUp/karyaUp_Website (Jul 7–Sep 2, 2026) across AI streaming, analytics, performance, SEO, and hosting migration.
Hardened KAI chatbot streaming with 1KB reverse-proxy flush, timeouts/abort signals, voice engines, and suggestion-chip UX.
Built first-party Analytics HQ (client-IP geo, demographics, bot filtering) and IP-based INR/USD geo pricing for live visitors.
Migrated blog media MongoDB → AWS S3/CloudFront; unblocked admin lists with projected lean card queries; ran PageSpeed/TBT optimization without gutting visuals.
Fixed SPA crawl SEO (canonicals, prerender, sitemaps), shipped KAI Agent surfaces, and migrated deep-link hosting from Render to Vercel.
Delivered FormX Consultants — 40+ route Next.js 16 / React 19 architectural consulting platform with a custom brand design system.
Built Navkar Tubes & Tools — industrial B2B site with interactive pipe weight calculator, MTC inspection UI, and Express serverless inquiry APIs.
Shipped Travebie (travebie.com), an AI travel booking platform with a 19-intent engine and 18 dynamic chat card UI components.
Added Playwright E2E coverage across booking/planner flows and PWA offline caching with a React Native admin companion.
